title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 27-Inch Solid Brass Euro Hook Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 27-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient roll storage without wall mounting with this freestanding toilet tissue stand. Crafted from solid brass with a heavy base to help prevent tipping, it’s designed for bathrooms where wall space is limited.

Highlights:
- Freestanding design requires no wall mounting and can be placed where you need it
- European style hook makes changing the roll quick and easy
- Solid brass construction for enduring strength
- Heavy base helps keep the stand stable
- Part of the Carolina collection for a coordinated bathroom look
- Multiple designer finish options available

Specs:
- Type: Freestanding toilet tissue stand
- Collection: Carolina
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 27-Inch H x 8-Inch L x 6-Inch W
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly: Required
- Included: Toilet tissue stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
